summary: Project-specific archives, local forms and materials are translated into reusable type, geometry and physical system primitives.
fit: Place-, culture-, craft- and community-led identities with legitimate source material.
avoid: Thin provenance, utility contexts, or culturally reductive borrowing.

summary: Recognition is increasingly carried by repeatable motion, rhythm or transformation rules while individual brand frames remain variable.
fit: High-frequency media, music, culture, social and event brands.
avoid: Low-frequency or tightly regulated identities without capacity to govern variation.

summary: Bounded hand gesture, physical process and irregular response are being designed into otherwise controlled identity systems.
fit: Creative, food, sport and community brands where process or tactility contributes meaning.
avoid: Cosmetic distress or interfaces where irregularity weakens legibility, state or trust.

summary: Expressive sites continue to carry grouping through typography, spacing, grids, labels and sequence instead of persistent surfaced containers.
fit: Brand, editorial, launch and portfolio experiences with moderate information density.
avoid: Dense transactional or data interfaces where explicit object and state boundaries matter.

summary: Repeat-use tools are increasing visible information and routing density while reducing shadows, decorative containers and control weight.
fit: Professional and operational products used frequently by returning users.
avoid: Novice or touch-first flows where stronger grouping and larger targets aid comprehension.

summary: AI generation is moving into directly manipulable canvases and task-specific workspaces tied to durable source artifacts or data.
fit: Creation, analysis and compositional workflows that benefit from multiple representations.
avoid: High-stakes workflows requiring fixed structure, predictable state location and strong auditability.

summary: Apple-platform UI increasingly separates edge-to-edge content from floating native navigation and action controls that adapt or recede.
fit: Native Apple media, reading, creation and communication apps.
avoid: Dense web/data UI or contexts where transparency and motion weaken contrast or affordance.

summary: Photographic and photoreal imagery is displacing rendered 3D and vector illustration as the default site imagery vocabulary.
fit: Hero and section imagery direction for product, AI and dev-tool sites.
avoid: Treating photography as mandatory; category mix carries part of the move.
